scope: Fixed development diagnostics only; all 20 preregistered seeds, four branches, no new simulation. All aggregates use the evaluation window unless explicitly final or burn-in.

verification.gap_comparison_method: Pair gap fields are checked against reconstruction summaries; the price gate uses simulation metrics. Independent daily reconstruction and summary/metric alignment use absolute tolerance 1e-11.

interpretation_limits: Paired full simulation paths on fixed development seeds; neither held-out validation nor Stage 1 completion.
Signed-gap cumulative components form an accounting identity. Their differences do not add to the nonlinear absolute-gap improvement.
Submitted notional is valued at opening prices; filled notional at execution prices. Gross filled totals sum absolute trader fills and are not canceled-flow price effects.
Wealth drawdowns are per-strategy aggregate mark-to-market drawdowns within the evaluation window, not individual-agent drawdown quantiles.
The candidate remains D; a favorable C result does not authorize changing the preregistered candidate.

market_gate_descriptive.interpretation: Counts apply the existing per-seed development criteria to these four diagnostic branches; this is not the full development or formal Stage 1 decision.
